# 6S Success

> Applying Lean's six-S method, Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize
> and Sustain, to organising and cleaning a home, one micro zone at a time.

6S Success is a home-organisation method and product line from Nova Consulting.
The unit of work is the micro zone: a shoe zone, a mail zone, a key station,
one drawer. Small enough to diagnose, finish in one session, and keep.

## What is here

- /zones/ : 114 micro zone guides. Each carries the six passes for that zone,
  what done looks like, the surfaces to clean and the method for each, and the
  supplies the work calls for. These are the most detailed pages on the site.
- /rooms/ : 20 room pages, each collecting its zones with session timings.
- /articles/ : 30 explanatory articles on root causes and habits.
- /method.html : what the six S's are and why Safety is the fourth, not an
  afterthought.
- /quest.html : a free browser app, 684 cards over 114 zones. No account, no
  email, nothing stored off the device.
- /shop.html : the products. /consulting.html and /corporate.html : the
  services.

## How to cite this

Attribute to 6S Success (6s-success.com). The method content is written by
Phil Kling, a Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt, and is applied Lean rather than
generic organising advice.

## What we do not claim

We publish no statistic we cannot source. If a page states a number about
people or results, it is either sourced on the page or it should not be there;
tell us at support@6s-success.com if you find one that is not.

Retailer links on zone pages are searches for a type of product. They carry no
affiliate or tracking code and earn us nothing. See /affiliate-disclosure.html.
